analysis_method.route_geometry_constraint: Previously evaluated I-95 / NJ Turnpike Exit 13A inbound geometry; the driving-time impedance was used to expose Esri historical traffic because the Map Viewer Trucking Time mode did not expose the same time-dependent traffic behavior.

summary.note: Single spot-check only; do not treat as a weekday distribution.

appointment_risk_interpretation.travel_only_threshold: A truck entering either approach fewer than 8 minutes before its appointment can miss under the observed typical traffic; every measured route requires at least 5 minutes.
appointment_risk_interpretation.recommended_normal_lead: 20 minutes before the appointment from the approach origin.
appointment_risk_interpretation.recommended_peak_or_incident_lead: 30 minutes before the appointment from the approach origin during 07:00-09:00 and 14:00-16:00, or when live incidents/closures are displayed.
appointment_risk_interpretation.regular_gate_cutoff: 16:00 Monday-Friday for empties, dry loads, and reefer loads.
appointment_risk_interpretation.oog_gate_cutoff: 15:30 Monday-Friday; OOG is outside the scoped standard-load analysis.
appointment_risk_interpretation.latest_observed_travel_only_departure_fo: 15:52 using the observed eight-minute maximum; this has no gate-queue allowance and is not an operational recommendation.

limitations: Esri time-dependent traffic estimates do not include queueing or processing time inside the terminal gate.
Historical traffic is not a guarantee against crashes, closures, construction, weather, or abnormal port surges.
Driving Time was used only as the traffic impedance on an independently evaluated truck corridor; it does not itself establish truck legality.
The northbound approach has one completed time-dependent spot-check and requires the same expanded weekday sampling before comparative claims are made.
